meta.title1.zh-Hans: 染色 — 札记 — Eva Maskalenko

meta.description1.en: Field Notes: Dyeing — where color enters the fiber-to-fabric chain, pigment vs. dye, why each fiber needs its own dye class, and cross dyeing two fibers in one bath. Animated.
meta.description1.zh-Hans: 札记：染色。颜色从纤维到面料的哪一步进入，颜料与染料的区别，为什么每种纤维要用自己的染料类别，以及两种纤维同浴染出两种颜色。配有动画。

hero.p1.en: Color can go in at almost any point in the chain — into the polymer before there is a fiber, into loose fiber, into yarn, or into finished fabric. Where it goes in, and which dye is used, decides how the color behaves for the rest of the product’s life.
hero.p1.zh-Hans: 颜色几乎可以在产业链的任何一步加进去：纤维还没成形时加到聚合物里，加到散纤维上，加到纱线上，或者加到织好的面料上。在哪一步上色、用哪一类染料，决定了这个颜色在产品整个使用寿命里的表现。

hero.p2.en: The fiber decides the dye: each fiber only takes the dye chemistry that can get into it, or hold on to it. Builds on Textile 101.
hero.p2.zh-Hans: 纤维决定染料：每种纤维只接受能进入它内部、或能抓住它的那一类染料。本篇以纺织基础为基础。

hero.a2.zh-Hans: 02在里面、在表面，还是进到里面

hero.a3.en: 03Why the Fiber Decides the Dye

where-color-enters.p1.en: Pick a stage and watch the dye go in there. Everything after it inherits the color; everything before it is still undyed.
where-color-enters.p1.zh-Hans: 选一个阶段，看染料从那里进入。它之后的每一步都带上这个颜色，它之前的每一步仍是未染色的。

where-color-enters.p2.en: The trade is always the same: the earlier the color goes in, the deeper and steadier it is — and the earlier you have to commit to it.
where-color-enters.p2.zh-Hans: 取舍始终是同一个：颜色进得越早，就越深、越稳定，但也必须越早把颜色定下来。

where-color-enters.aria2.en: Four panels left to right: polymer, fiber, yarn, fabric. Dye drops into the chosen stage; that stage and every stage after it turn the dye color, the ones before it stay white.
where-color-enters.aria2.zh-Hans: 从左到右四格：聚合物、纤维、纱线、面料。染料落进所选的阶段；这一阶段和它之后的各阶段变成染料的颜色，之前的各阶段保持白色。

where-color-enters.span8.en: Color goes in deeper and steadier — less structure already built to distort
where-color-enters.span8.zh-Hans: 颜色进得更深、更稳定：已经成形、可能被染色破坏的结构更少

where-color-enters.span9.en: Color decided later — more flexibility, shorter lead time
where-color-enters.span9.zh-Hans: 颜色定得更晚：更灵活，交货期更短

where-color-enters.p3.en: Pigment goes into the melted polymer before the fiber exists, so the color is the fiber. The most fade-resistant in sunlight, and there’s no dye bath, so no dye effluent. But the color is chosen before anything else is.
where-color-enters.p3.zh-Hans: 纤维还不存在时，颜料就加进了熔融的聚合物，所以颜色就是纤维本身。它在日晒下最不容易褪色；因为不用染浴，也就没有染色废水。但颜色必须在其他一切之前定下来。

where-color-enters.p4.en: Loose fiber is dyed before it’s spun into yarn, so the color runs all the way through every yarn made from it.* Staple fibers only — the short kind (cotton, wool, cut polyester or nylon). A continuous filament can’t be dyed loose.
where-color-enters.p4.zh-Hans: 散纤维在纺成纱之前染色，所以用它纺出的每一根纱，颜色都是里外一致的。* 只适用于短纤维，也就是较短的那一类（棉、羊毛、切断的聚酯纤维（涤纶）或聚酰胺纤维（锦纶））。连续的长丝没法以散纤维的形式染色。

where-color-enters.p5.en: Yarn dyed in big, loose loops — relaxed, so it keeps its bulk and a soft hand. Dyed yarn is what makes stripes, checks and heathers possible.If elastane is already in the yarn or fabric, the hot dye bath can cost it stretch. Color put in earlier, or into the polymer, avoids that.
where-color-enters.p5.zh-Hans: 纱线绕成松散的大圈来染。纱处于松弛状态，所以能保持蓬松和柔软的手感。有了染好色的纱，才织得出条纹、格子和[[heather!]]。若纱线或面料里已经含有氨纶，高温染浴可能让它损失弹性。把上色提前，或直接在聚合物阶段着色，就能避开这个问题。

where-color-enters.p6.en: Yarn wound tight on a perforated core, with the dye pumped through it under pressure. Dyed yarn is what makes stripes, checks and heathers possible.If elastane is already in the yarn or fabric, the hot dye bath can cost it stretch. Color put in earlier, or into the polymer, avoids that.
where-color-enters.p6.zh-Hans: 纱线紧紧卷绕在多孔筒管上，染液在压力下被泵送穿过纱层。有了染好色的纱，才织得出条纹、格子和[[heather]]。不同颜色的纤维混在同一根纱里，就会形成这种深浅夹杂的外观。若纱线或面料里已经含有氨纶，高温染浴可能让它损失弹性。把上色提前，或直接在聚合物阶段着色，就能避开这个问题。

where-color-enters.p7.en: A whole sheet of warp yarns, side by side under tension, dyed together on one beam — ready to weave.If elastane is already in the yarn or fabric, the hot dye bath can cost it stretch. Color put in earlier, or into the polymer, avoids that.
where-color-enters.p7.zh-Hans: 整幅经纱在张力下并排卷在一根经轴上一起染色，染完就可以上机织造。若纱线或面料里已经含有氨纶，高温染浴可能让它损失弹性。把上色提前，或直接在聚合物阶段着色，就能避开这个问题。

where-color-enters.p8.en: The finished fabric is dyed. The color is decided last, with the shortest lead time — but everything is already built: in a tight fabric the dye may not reach the middle of every yarn.If elastane is already in the fabric, the hot dye bath can cost it stretch. Garments can be dyed later still, after they’re sewn.
where-color-enters.p8.zh-Hans: 织好的面料再染色。颜色最后才定，交货期最短；但一切结构都已成形：在紧密的面料里，染料可能到不了每根纱线的中心。若面料里已经含有氨纶，高温染浴可能让它损失弹性。成衣还可以更晚染色，缝好以后再染。

where-color-enters.div1.en: Three ways to dye yarn — three different states of the yarn
where-color-enters.div1.zh-Hans: 染纱的三种方式，纱线的三种状态

where-color-enters.aria3.en: Loose loops of yarn hang from a rod; the dye bath rises around them and the loops take the color
where-color-enters.aria3.zh-Hans: 松散的纱圈挂在一根杆上；染浴在四周升起，纱圈染上颜色

where-color-enters.span12.en: Loose loops hang in the bath, so the yarn stays lofty and soft — but it has to be rewound before it can be used.
where-color-enters.span12.zh-Hans: 松散的纱圈悬挂在染浴里，所以纱线保持蓬松柔软；但使用前必须重新络纱。

where-color-enters.aria4.en: Cross-section of yarn wound in rings around a perforated core; dye is pumped out through the core, then back in, until every ring is colored
where-color-enters.aria4.zh-Hans: 纱线一圈圈卷绕在多孔筒管上的截面；染液先从筒管向外泵出，再向内泵回，直到每一圈都染上颜色

where-color-enters.span15.en: Wound to a set density on a perforated core; the dye is pumped through, inside out and then outside in.
where-color-enters.span15.zh-Hans: 按设定的密度卷绕在多孔筒管上；染液被泵送穿过纱层，先由内向外，再由外向内。

where-color-enters.aria5.en: Parallel yarns stretched between a bar and a perforated beam; dye rises up through all of them at once
where-color-enters.aria5.zh-Hans: 平行的纱线绷在一根横杆和一根多孔经轴之间；染液同时穿过所有纱线向上升

where-color-enters.span18.en: The whole warp, side by side on one perforated beam, dyed in one go.
where-color-enters.span18.zh-Hans: 整幅经纱并排卷在一根多孔经轴上，一次染完。

where-color-enters.div2.en: How far the dye gets: one yarn, cut across
where-color-enters.div2.zh-Hans: 染料能到多深：一根纱线的横截面

where-color-enters.aria6.en: Cross-section of a round yarn made of many fibers; the color moves in from the outside until every fiber is colored
where-color-enters.aria6.zh-Hans: 由许多纤维组成的圆形纱线的截面；颜色从外向内推进，直到每根纤维都染上颜色

where-color-enters.span20.en: The dye has room to reach every fiber, right to the middle.
where-color-enters.span20.zh-Hans: 染料有足够的空间到达每一根纤维，一直到纱线中心。

where-color-enters.aria7.en: Cross-section of a yarn squeezed flat by its neighbours in a fabric; the outer fibers take the color but the middle ones stay mostly undyed
where-color-enters.aria7.zh-Hans: 面料中被相邻纱线挤扁的一根纱线的截面；外层纤维染上了颜色，中间的纤维大多没有染上

where-color-enters.span22.en: Squeezed by its neighbours in a tight fabric, the yarn can take the color mostly at its surface and leave its middle under-dyed — called ring dyeing.
where-color-enters.span22.zh-Hans: 在紧密的面料里，纱线被相邻的纱挤紧，颜色可能主要留在纱线表层，芯部染得偏浅：这种现象叫[[ring-dyeing]]。

pigment-vs-dye.h21.zh-Hans: 在里面、在表面，还是进到里面

pigment-vs-dye.p1.en: Pigment and dye are different things. Pigment is solid particles; it has no hold on a fiber of its own, so it’s either locked inside the polymer or glued onto the surface. Dye is molecules that go into the fiber.
pigment-vs-dye.p1.zh-Hans: 颜料和染料是两回事。颜料是固体颗粒，自己抓不住纤维，所以要么被锁在聚合物内部，要么被粘在纤维表面。染料是分子，会进入纤维内部。

pigment-vs-dye.aria1.en: Cross-section of a fiber; pigment particles are stirred into it while it is still melted, then it sets with particles all through it
pigment-vs-dye.aria1.zh-Hans: 一根纤维的截面；纤维还处于熔融状态时颜料颗粒被搅拌进去，凝固后颗粒遍布整根纤维

pigment-vs-dye.span3.en: Pigment mixed into the polymer before it’s spun. The color is part of the fiber.
pigment-vs-dye.span3.zh-Hans: 纺丝之前把颜料混进聚合物。颜色是纤维的一部分。

pigment-vs-dye.aria2.en: Cross-section of a white fiber; pigment particles land on its top surface and a binder film coats over them; the inside stays white
pigment-vs-dye.aria2.zh-Hans: 一根白色纤维的截面；颜料颗粒落在它的上表面，一层粘合剂薄膜覆盖其上；内部仍是白色

pigment-vs-dye.span6.en: Particles held on by a binder. A stiff print can restrict stretch and crack; heavy pigment changes the hand, and it can rub off.
pigment-vs-dye.span6.zh-Hans: 颗粒靠粘合剂固定在表面。印得硬会限制拉伸并开裂；颜料上得厚会改变手感，还可能被摩擦掉。

pigment-vs-dye.aria3.en: Cross-section of a fiber in a dye bath; small dye molecules move from the bath into the fiber and spread through it
pigment-vs-dye.aria3.zh-Hans: 染浴中一根纤维的截面；细小的染料分子从染浴进入纤维，并在其中扩散开

pigment-vs-dye.span9.en: Dye molecules go into the fiber — dissolved in it, or bonded to it, depending on the dye.
pigment-vs-dye.span9.zh-Hans: 染料分子进入纤维内部：有的溶在里面，有的与纤维成键，取决于染料的种类。

dye-classes.h21.en: Why the Fiber Decides the Dye

dye-classes.p1.en: Zoom into a fiber and it’s long chains of molecules. A dye only works on a fiber if it can get in among those chains and stay there — and each fiber offers a different way to hold on.
dye-classes.p1.zh-Hans: 把纤维放大看，它是一条条长长的分子链。染料要对某种纤维起作用，就得能钻进这些链之间并留在那里；而每种纤维留住染料的方式各不相同。

dye-classes.p2.en: So each fiber has its dye class: disperse for polyester, acid for nylon, reactive for cotton.
dye-classes.p2.zh-Hans: 所以每种纤维有自己的染料类别：聚酯纤维（涤纶）用分散染料，聚酰胺纤维（锦纶）用酸性染料，棉用活性染料。

dye-classes.aria1.en: Polyester chains, packed tight; heat to 130 degrees loosens them, small round dye molecules slip in between, then the chains close and trap them
dye-classes.aria1.zh-Hans: 紧密排列的涤纶分子链；加热到 130 度使它们松开，小而圆的染料分子钻进链间，随后分子链合拢，把染料困在里面

dye-classes.span3.en: Polyester has nothing for a dye to grab. Hot and under pressure, its chains loosen; tiny dye molecules slip in and stay trapped when it cools.
dye-classes.span3.zh-Hans: 涤纶上没有可供染料抓住的位置。在高温高压下，它的分子链松开；细小的染料分子钻进去，冷却后就被困在里面。

dye-classes.aria2.en: Nylon chains with a few sites; in an acid bath each site gains a plus sign; dye molecules marked minus move in and pair with the plus sites
dye-classes.aria2.zh-Hans: 带有少量位点的锦纶分子链；在酸性浴中每个位点得到一个正号；带负号的染料分子靠过来，与带正号的位点配对

dye-classes.span4.zh-Hans: 酸性染料 → 锦纶（以及羊毛）

dye-classes.span6.en: In an acid bath the fiber’s sites pick up a + charge; the dye carries a −, and they pair up. Nylon has only a few of these sites, wool many.
dye-classes.span6.zh-Hans: 在酸性浴中，纤维上的[[dye-sites]]带上正电荷；染料带负电荷，两者配成一对。这种位置锦纶上只有少量，羊毛上很多。

dye-classes.aria3.en: Cotton chains; dye molecules settle onto them, then with alkali each forms a solid bond to the chain; dye that reacted with the water instead is washed away
dye-classes.aria3.zh-Hans: 棉的分子链；染料分子落在链上，加碱后各自与分子链形成牢固的键；与水反应掉的染料被洗去

dye-classes.span9.en: With alkali, the dye bonds to the cotton itself. Some dye reacts with the water instead — it can’t bond, so it’s washed off.
dye-classes.span9.zh-Hans: 加碱后，染料与棉本身成键。一部分染料却与水发生了反应，无法再成键，所以要洗掉。

cross-dyeing.h21.en: One Bath, Two Dyes — Cross Dyeing
cross-dyeing.h21.zh-Hans: 一浴两种染料：异色效果

cross-dyeing.p1.en: Because each dye only takes to its own fiber, a fabric woven from two fibers — here a polyester warp and a nylon weft — can go into one bath with two dyes and come out two colors. That’s cross dyeing.
cross-dyeing.p1.zh-Hans: 因为每种染料只上自己的那种纤维，一块由两种纤维[[interwoven]]的面料（这里经纱是涤纶，纬纱是锦纶）可以放进同一个染浴、用两种染料，染出两种颜色。这就是[[cross-dyeing]]。

cross-dyeing.p2.en: Choose the two dyes to match instead and the same bath gives one solid color: union dyeing.
cross-dyeing.p2.zh-Hans: 如果把两种染料选配成同一个颜色，同一个染浴染出的就是单色：这叫[[union-dyeing]]。

cross-dyeing.button1.en: Reserve: leave the acid dye out

cross-dyeing.aria2.en: A swatch woven with a polyester warp and a nylon weft sits in a dye bath with round disperse dye molecules and diamond-shaped acid dye molecules; each kind moves to its own fiber, so the polyester turns one color and the nylon another
cross-dyeing.aria2.zh-Hans: 一块经纱为涤纶、纬纱为锦纶的机织小样浸在染浴里，浴中有圆形的分散染料分子和菱形的酸性染料分子；两种分子各自移向自己的纤维，于是涤纶变成一种颜色，锦纶变成另一种颜色

cross-dyeing.span1.en: Disperse dye → polyester, the warp: the smooth, straight filaments running up and down
cross-dyeing.span1.zh-Hans: 分散染料 → 涤纶（经纱）：上下方向、平滑挺直的长丝

cross-dyeing.span2.en: Acid dye → nylon, the weft: the crimped filaments running across
cross-dyeing.span2.zh-Hans: 酸性染料 → 锦纶（纬纱）：横向、带卷曲的长丝

cross-dyeing.p3.en: Reserve dyeing. Leave one dye out and that fiber comes out undyed — a two-tone, or a heather if the two fibers are blended in the yarn instead. In practice disperse dye stains nylon slightly, so a true white reserve is easier on polyester/cotton.
cross-dyeing.p3.zh-Hans: [[reserve-dyeing]]。少加一种染料，对应的那种纤维就不上色：得到双色效果；如果两种纤维是混纺在同一根纱里的，得到的就是{{heather}}。实际生产中，分散染料会让锦纶轻微[[cross-staining]]，所以要留出真正的白色，涤纶/棉更容易做到。

cross-dyeing.p4.en: Polyester with cotton is harder: disperse dye wants a hot, acidic bath and reactive dye an alkaline one. So the two usually run in the same bath as two steps, one after the other.
cross-dyeing.p4.zh-Hans: 涤纶配棉更难：分散染料要高温的酸性浴，活性染料要碱性浴。所以两者通常在同一个染浴里分两步进行，一先一后。

js:pumped through: inside → out.zh-Hans: 泵送染液：由内 → 向外

js:every layer dyed, wound tight.zh-Hans: 每一层都染到，卷绕紧密

js:every end dyed together, side by side.en: every end dyed together, side by side

js:set as a fiber: pigment all through i.en: set as a fiber: pigment all through it
js:set as a fiber: pigment all through i.zh-Hans: 凝固成纤维：颜料遍布其中

js:glued to the surface: the inside stay.en: glued to the surface: the inside stays bare
js:glued to the surface: the inside stay.zh-Hans: 粘在表面：内部没有颜色

js:cooled: the dye is trapped, not bonde.en: cooled: the dye is trapped, not bonded
js:cooled: the dye is trapped, not bonde.zh-Hans: 冷却：染料被困住，没有成键

js:acid bath: the fiber’s sites pick up.en: acid bath: the fiber’s sites pick up a +
js:acid bath: the fiber’s sites pick up.zh-Hans: 酸性浴：纤维上的位点带上 +

js:add alkali: it bonds to the fiber (co.en: add alkali: it bonds to the fiber (covalent)
js:add alkali: it bonds to the fiber (co.zh-Hans: 加碱：与纤维成键（共价键）

js:wash off the dye that reacted with wa.en: wash off the dye that reacted with water

js:what stays is bonded to the cotton.en: what stays is bonded to the cotton

js:one bath, one dye: the acid dye is le.en: one bath, one dye: the acid dye is left out
js:one bath, one dye: the acid dye is le.zh-Hans: 一浴一种染料：不加酸性染料

js:a clearing rinse takes the stray dye.en: a clearing rinse takes the stray dye back off the nylon
js:a clearing rinse takes the stray dye.zh-Hans: 清洗把沾错的染料从锦纶上洗掉

js:some disperse dye lands on the nylon.en: some disperse dye lands on the nylon too
js:some disperse dye lands on the nylon.zh-Hans: 有些分散染料也沾到了锦纶上

js:disperse dye finds the polyester; the.en: disperse dye finds the polyester; the nylon stays undyed
js:disperse dye finds the polyester; the.zh-Hans: 分散染料上到涤纶；锦纶不上色

js:each dye goes to its own fiber.en: each dye goes to its own fiber
js:each dye goes to its own fiber.zh-Hans: 每种染料各上各的纤维
